arabicExcerpts.text: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمٞ فِي يَوۡمٖ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةٖ
ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ

mainSubject.label: The gifts of two eyes, a tongue and two lips, and the guidance to the two ways recalled as proof that man was equipped but failed to break through the steep pass — whose meaning is questioned and answered as freeing a slave, feeding on a day of severe hunger an orphan of near relationship or a needy person in misery, then being among those who believe and advise one another to patience and compassion

subordinateSubjects.label: A tongue and two lips provided
The two ways shown to him clearly
Yet he has not broken through the steep pass
The nature of the steep pass questioned rhetorically
It is the freeing of a slave
Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
Or a needy person in misery
Then being among believers who advise patience and compassion
